name: Akkeshi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Akkeshi town emblem in navy: a stylised swirl with a pointed wing, like a bird in flight.
history: Municipal flag of Akkeshi, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 June 1964.

features.role: Akkeshi town emblem — a stylised swirl with a pointed wing, like a bird in flight
